triples.evidence: render.mjs Playwright harness emulating the host's rules
Hosting finding 1: under the artifact CSP, CDN X_ITE cannot fetch its fonts, sorter wasm or stylesheet (shadow root), so splats, Text and PLY never load and canvases collapse.
Self-hosting X_ITE beside the page fixes it; the loader (tools/snippets/xite-loader.html) falls back to the CDN and repairs the stylesheet.
Hosting finding 2: the host serves only pages, styles, scripts (.js .mjs .wasm), data (.json .txt .md .xml .csv), images, fonts, media and PDF; it refuses .ply .glb .spz .x3dz under any contentType

triples.o: Encoding binary assets as base64 txt parts
